title: Why Sitting All Day Feels Like a Marathon 🧠
caption:
You didn't lift a thing all day. So why are you exhausted?

In 2022, scientists in Paris found glutamate building up in the part of the brain that does the hard thinking after a long day of mental work. It's an early finding, but you've felt it.

Which level of tired are you on right now? 👇
